subject.title: [Bug]: Block streaming can drop paragraph separators across streamed updates

question: Should the permanent block-streaming contract preserve paragraph boundaries as in-band text on chunks, carry explicit boundary metadata through delivery, or intentionally accept a limited text-only repair for common cases?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and two candidate PRs exist, but their discussion shows the near-maxChars boundary case needs an explicit maintainer choice about the streaming payload contract.

options.title: Consolidate a complete shared fix
options.body: Choose one candidate or replacement and require it to preserve paragraph boundaries across both in-budget and near-maxChars splits before merging.

options.title: Adopt explicit boundary metadata
options.body: Ask contributors to carry paragraph/newline/hard-split seam metadata through chunker, subscriber, and coalescer if text-only chunks cannot satisfy all invariants.

options.title: Accept a partial text-only repair
options.body: Maintainers may land a common-case separator fix while leaving the exact near-limit boundary documented as remaining work on this issue.

recommendation.title: Consolidate a complete shared fix
recommendation.body: Choose one candidate or replacement and require it to preserve paragraph boundaries across both in-budget and near-maxChars splits before merging.

likelyOwner.reason: This account has the strongest recent history across coalescing, chunking hardening, streaming docs, and current-file layout, making it the best available owner for the contract choice.
